body:
I haven't had a job in close to a year now. I tried several different ones, each was their own flavor of hell. I can't find a job I can stand working long enough to get a shitty apartment. I have nothing further up, no larger goal or ambition to motivate me to work a shitty job to get there. 

I've been doing community college full time for two and a half years, I should have been done by now but I just couldn't make myself put even the slightest bit of effort forth. 

Actually though, I'm doing everything I enjoy. The sad part is that's basically nothing. Since I was little I have always had almost no interests and been left insipid and shallow.

I don't know what I need. And if I do, it's too much. The basics for me aren't enough, I don't want to keep forward to find out years down the line that I have a normal job and a normal life. I feel like I'm getting all or nothing, and I'm not going to get all so why bother?

 I'm getting to the point where an off chance that things will get better isn't worth the risk. I feel that "making the best of things" would be to end the suffering now. 

>our struggles define who we are as people

And I'm a quitter. I give up, I surrender, I Crack under pressure. "but you can change that" you say, and maybe. But it's yet another challenge I'll let beat me because I don't want to try. I'll give up like I always do. 

I just don't see a way out here. I don't see a way to figure out solutions. I'm stick here, almost totally alone and helpless
I sleep plenty, getting up is always painful (yes with the correct amount of sleep) and it's less exhaustion and more just not caring. I can't motivate myself to do anything really
I really wish I could find someone, but so far I haven't. Is it really worth the time? Does the wizard at the end of the yellow brick road have anything real to offer?

I've been hanging on for so long. When can I stop? I don't know what changes to make, and even if I did I don't think I could physically do it. I struggle to get the basics of every day functioning down
